facts.text: em2.py is the ALBA EM2 client
SCPI_CONTROL_PORT is 5025 and ZMQ_STREAMING_PORT is 22003
Em2 creates a SCPI TCP socket to (host, port) and a ZMQ stream receiver
The electrometer channels are numbered 1 to 4
Channel.current reads CHANxx:INSC? and converts the reply to float
Channel.range reads and writes CHANxx:CABO:RANGE
Channel.inversion reads CHANxx:CABO:INVE?, returns True only for 'On', and the setter writes 'On' or 'Off'
The amplifier range list runs from 1 mA to 100 pA
MINIMUM_INTEGRATION_TIME_MS is 0.1 and MAXIMUM_INTEGRATION_TIME_WITHOUT_OVERFLOW_MS is 2621.0
LoadOne refuses an integration time below 0.1 ms or above 2621.0 ms
Em2.acquisition_time is in seconds on the client and is sent to the device in milliseconds
Em2.idn queries *idn?
Em2.acquisition_state queries ACQU:STAT? and returns the suffix after STATE_
Em2.nb_points queries ACQU:NTRIG? and writes ACQU:NTRIG <value>
Em2.nb_points_ready returns the number of received streaming points or queries ACQU:NDAT?
Em2.trigger_mode, trigger_input, trigger_polarity, trigger_precision and trigger_delay read and write the TRIG:* settings; the delay is in seconds on the client and milliseconds on the wire
Em2.software_trigger sends TRIG:SWSE True
Em2.start_acquisition sends ACQU:START, appending SWTRIG when soft_trigger is true
Em2.stop_acquisition sends ACQU:STOP True and stops the ZMQ receiver
Em2.timestamp_data reads TMST? and writes TMST True/False
The alternate controller names the acquisition modes CHARGE, CURRENT and STREAMING
The manual test names the trigger modes SOFTWARE, HARDWARE, GATE, AUTOTRIGGER and HW_AUTOTRIGGER
